text: {"sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END AS outdoor_temp_band, COUNT(*) AS total_incidents, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN false_alarm = true THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS false_alarm_share_percent FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END ORDER BY total_incidents DESC", "columns": ["outdoor_temp_band", "total_incidents", "false_alarm_share_percent"], "purpose": "Aggregate machine_overheat incidents by outdoor temperature bands and compute false alarm share to assess if alarms increase with temperature."}

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END AS outdoor_temp_band, COUNT(*) AS total_incidents, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN false_alarm = true THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS false_alarm_share_percent FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END ORDER BY total_incidents DESC
data.purpose: Aggregate machine_overheat incidents by outdoor temperature bands and compute false alarm share to assess if alarms increase with temperature.
